papers.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
papers.abstract: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, simply increasing environments does not always benefit. This work studies diversity and difficulty structure.

papers.title: DCAS: Decoupling CLI Agent Scaffolding to Internalize Planning across Scaffolds
papers.abstract: CLI-based software-engineering agents show performance degradation across non-training scaffolds. Proposes backend-substitution interception layer enabling cross-scaffold evaluation and planning-aware trajectory collection.

papers.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
papers.abstract: Population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure for testing AI systems with heterogeneous users. Contains 8.3 billion persona records across 1,290 dimensions with applications spanning commerce, finance, healthcare.

papers.title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
papers.abstract: Language models trained to answer questions about internal activations can become concept-specific anti-readers. Shows behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and oracle-verbalizability can diverge significantly.

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
papers.abstract: Practitioner's study on efficient distillation training. Offline KD runs 29% faster per iteration; fused chunked KL loss enables four times larger context on single GPU, making peak memory linear in sequence length.

papers.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
papers.abstract: Hard prompt compression can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining answers while deleting entity definitions. At 0.30 compression ratio, 34-54% of bridge examples show incomplete answer paths across datasets.

papers.title: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
papers.abstract: Trains fourteen models from 135M to 14B parameters on Psych-101 dataset of 10.7 million trial-level choices. Shows 0.6B-1B parameters suffice in-distribution; larger models advantaged out-of-distribution on novel task structures.

papers.title: Multi-Agent Forensic Reasoning for Generalizable Deepfake Video Detection
papers.abstract: Introduces FaceVid-Forensics-100K with 100,000 deepfake videos spanning 33 synthesis methods. Multi-agent framework with four domain-expert agents analyzing texture, lighting, motion, and physics outperforms GPT and Gemini.

papers.title: Zero Gap Is Not Restoration: Stratified Per-Question Probability Evaluation and Step-wise Mitigation of Benchmark Contamination
papers.abstract: Proposes SA-PPG metric to evaluate benchmark contamination mitigation more accurately than existing G-AP metric. Introduces RailCap strategy that caps tokens to suppress memorization during generation process.

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images
papers.abstract: Proposes DualIFM foundation model with interpretable-by-design approach using BagNet backbone. Trained on 800,000+ fundus photographs; achieves performance comparable to RETFound with 16x fewer parameters.

cc_updates.body: Added gateway spend-limit support to Claude Code's usage warning; the limit-reached message now names the cap, its reset time, and the operator's message (requires the gateway on 2.1.225). Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`. Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart. Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors, as if never authenticated, after a keychain read timed out. Fixed auto mode counting a safety-filter refusal of its own permission check toward the consecutive-block limit; the action is still denied, but the model is now told to move on rather than retry. Fixed cross-session messages staying parked without a notice or expiry in headless sessions and during startup.

Added self-hosted environments: `claude self-hosted-runner` turns your own machines or containers into a place Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions can run, on Team and Enterprise plans. Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning. Added a cancel-and-confirm step when removing an unavailable paste changes a command's text. Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile over the `AWS_REGION`-derived one. Added `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry` settings: cross-session messages sent to a session running with bypassed permissions are held for your approval, and messages to other sessions auto-deliver.
